items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: New Jersey drops Coinbase staking order ahead of crypto's midterm test
items.summary: New Jersey lifted its staking ban and dropped a $5 million penalty, clearing the way for Coinbase to restore staking access for users in the US state.

items.title: AI poses greater threat to Bitcoin than quantum computing, Swan founder says
items.summary: The Swan Bitcoin founder warned that hackers are using large language models to exploit security flaws with just a few prompts.

items.title: Crypto investigators flag suspected $106M theft, $786K Solana bot drain
items.summary: A European entity may have lost $106 million from exchange accounts, while a wallet associated with a Solana arbitrage bot may have lost another $786,000.

items.title: Coinbase hit with 50% price target cut as post-earnings rout deepens
items.summary: Slowing trading activity and fallout from the Binance hack are clouding Coinbase's revenue prospects, prompting Morgan Stanley to lower its rating on the stock.

items.title: Bitcoin risks drop below $76K as 7% oil slide fails to spark BTC price rally
items.summary: Bitcoin fell around 1.7% on Monday as stocks pared early gains fueled by hopes of a diplomatic resolution to the US-Iran war.

items.title: Bitcoin Firm Strive Climbs Up the Treasury Ranks With Another Big Buy
items.summary: Strive added 124 Bitcoin for about $10 million and now trails Twenty One Capital by 390 BTC for third place among Treasury companies.

items.title: Mystery $106 Million Crypto Theft Hits EU Entity Days After Binance Hack
items.summary: Onchain investigator ZachXBT says an unidentified EU entity lost more than $106 million from centralized exchange accounts on Sunday,.

items.title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
items.summary: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.

items.title: Tom Lee Calls Bottom on AI Stock Selloff, Citing Tight Supply and Crypto Resilience
items.summary: The Fundstrat strategist says constraints on AI spending have slowed growth without ending the boom, while crypto's response to the Binance hack suggests sellers may already be exhausted.

items.title: North Korea Is Laundering Binance Hack Loot at One New Wallet Every 25 Seconds
items.summary: $2.85 billion of the $6.43 billion stolen from Binance has been frozen or seized, compared with about 3% in the Bybit hack, as North Korea's automated laundering spans 12,000 wallets.

items.title: Proton Users Revolt After CEO Calls Security Caution 'Loser Thinking' Amid AI Push
items.summary: Proton customers say they are canceling subscriptions after reports of pressure to adopt AI coding, as the privacy company scraps employee re-interviews but defends its broader shift toward automated development.

items.title: Kim Jong-Un's sister rejects FBI claims linking North Korea to record $6 billion Binance hack: reports
items.summary: North Korea is now reportedly saying it was not behind the hack, despite the FBI finding that North Korean hackers were behind the heist.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin, Brazil's largest crypto exchange, hit by $46 million security breach
items.summary: Brazil's largest crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin confirmed earlier Monday a security incident and paused withdrawals.

items.title: DTCC's tokenization launch could accelerate adoption and boost Securitize, StoneX says
items.summary: StoneX says DTCC's tokenization service validates Securitize's model, reiterating its buy rating on SECZ as the firm expands tokenized stocks.

items.title: Binance completes latest proof of reserves as it works to restore assets, withdrawals after record hack
items.summary: Binance users can now independently verify 1:1 backing for BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP and more as it replenishes 95% of assets lost in record hack.

items.title: Strive inches closer to becoming second-largest public bitcoin holder after latest $10 million buy
items.summary: Strive bought another 124 BTC, bringing it closer to becoming the second-largest public company holder of bitcoin after Strategy.

items.title: Bitmine adds 8,573 ETH as Tom Lee flags muted Binance hack reaction
items.summary: Bitmine added 8,573 ETH last week, lifting holdings to 6.06 million ETH, as Tom Lee flagged muted market response to Binance's hack.

items.title: Binance hack freeze hits 44% as Lazarus launders funds through automated scripts
items.summary: The Binance hack response has frozen 44% of the stolen funds so far, while Lazarus Group is using automated scripts to launder the rest across thousands of wallets.

items.title: Bitcoin price faces $76K test as oil drop fails to lift risk assets
items.summary: BTC slid as macro risk-off persisted despite a sharp oil price decline.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin pauses withdrawals after $46M security incident
items.summary: Brazil's top exchange confirmed a breach and halted withdrawals while investigating.

items.title: Strategy and Strive continue Bitcoin accumulation amid market caution
items.summary: Public treasuries keep buying BTC even as price action stays muted post-hack.

items.title: Tokenized stocks face pushback from major firms as NYSE plans advance
items.summary: Nvidia, Nike and others object to tokenized equity trading plans.

items.title: BNB ETF inflows preceded Binance hack, data shows
items.summary: Largest BNB ETF allocations arrived weeks before the exchange incident.
